pages.text: About SafethriftBuilt around people. Growing through trust.We’re developing a member-owned, interest-free financial cooperative with a simple ambition: turn savings into opportunity, without exploitation.The organisation and proposed services are in development.Our purposeFair finance begins with shared responsibility.A savings habit is personal. The opportunity it creates can be shared.Why Safethrift existsWe aim to serve people and small businesses who are often excluded by traditional financial systems. Responsible saving, mutual support and community ownership are the ideas behind the proposal.Our missionTo provide fair, interest-free financial access by enabling people and small businesses to build opportunity through disciplined saving, shared responsibility, and cooperative ownership.Our visionTo create strong, self-reliant communities that finance growth and opportunity together.We are preparing our organisation and proposed services; we are not accepting deposits or providing loans through this website.Our valuesPrinciples to put into practice.01Champion inclusionDesign for people with different backgrounds, circumstances and income patterns.02Enable changeSupport positive financial habits through education and transparent processes.03Expand opportunityHelp individuals, families and small businesses work towards meaningful goals.04Interest-free supportDevelop a responsible alternative built around saving and shared responsibility.05Invest in communitiesKeep community benefit central to the model and its future development.06Be accountableMake room for member participation, clear information and responsible oversight.Community ownership & governanceA future shaped by its members.The proposed structure is a member-owned cooperative, with democratic participation and accountable oversight. Legal structure and governance arrangements remain subject to confirmation.01 / Proposed roleMember participationThe intention is for members to have a voice in key decisions and the election of directors, subject to approved governing documents.02 / Proposed roleBoard oversightThe proposed board would oversee strategy, financial responsibility, transparency and compliance.03 / Proposed roleDay-to-day managementA future management team would be responsible for delivering services and reporting to the board.Organisational informationVerified details, when confirmed.Information pendingTeam & founding directorsVerified team biographies and appointments will be shared here when confirmed. No director or board appointments are announced on this website.No current vacanciesContributing to SafethriftFuture opportunities to contribute will be published here. There are currently no advertised roles or application channels on this website.Clear answersTransparency from the start.Understanding the proposal should come before any commitment.Can I open an account or apply for support now?+No. Safethrift is in development. Savings accounts, lending and online membership applications are not available through this website. Launch information will be published when confirmed.What does interest-free mean?+Interest-free support is part of Safethrift’s proposed model. Product terms, any charges and eligibility would need to be confirmed and published before a service becomes available.Does membership guarantee access to finance?+No. Membership would be a commitment to shared values and participation. Any future financial support would be subject to approved terms and assessment.Is Safethrift already registered or authorised?+This website does not confirm incorporation, financial services authorisation or deposit protection. Verified organisational and regulatory details will be published when available. No funds are being accepted here.Get to know SafethriftA shared purpose.A part to play.Explore what membership would mean, before applications open.Explore membershipNo applications or payments are accepted here.
